mensagens.input: At the office picnic, your team tries to make a record-winning key lime pie that serves 400. It's a team-building exercise that improves morale. Then everybody eats it.<br><br>Part 1) If the children eat 163 slices, what percentage have they eaten?<br><br>Part 2) If the C.E.O. donates 78 slices to the local homeless shelter at the end of the day, what percentage did he donate?
